fixed_parameters.view_association: Mutual-best same-class predicted-box IoU >=0.50, independent of reference
fixed_parameters.view_disagreement: Maximum corresponding-corner distance across contrast and enlarged views

limitations: Post-hoc descriptive ranking on 20 reused development images; outputs from the same photo are correlated.
Reference box overlap is an evaluation-only oracle feature.
Ranking cohort contains matched fronts with two reference corners and both returned points; it excludes unmatched/incomplete-reference outputs.
All quality scores are compared on the same fixed common-view subset; its exclusions are reported.
No thresholds fitted or recommended. No confidence calibration or generalization claim.
Reference assignments are evaluation identities, not physical proof of correspondence.
